item.name: Chthonian Chains
item.description:
The Ever Burning Plate Armor Depicts Three Canine Heads With Serpentine Chains Draping From Their Maws Covering The Wearer’s Arms. While Wearing This Armor You Gain A +3 Bonus To Your AC And You Have [[Resistance (Damage)]] To Fire Damage. This Armor Can Hold Up To 6 Charges, Regaining 1d6+1 Charges Daily At Dusk.
**𝙁𝙖𝙣𝙜𝙨 𝙤𝙛 𝙏𝙖𝙧𝙩𝙖𝙧𝙪𝙨:** You Can Make A Melee Weapon Attack With The Chains That Decorate This Armor Against A Target Within 10ft Of You. You Are Considered [[Proficiency]] With The Chain And This Attack Gains A +1 Bonus To Attack And Damage Rolls For Each Charge This Armor Has (Maximum Of +3). On A Hit The Target Takes An Amount Of *Piercing* Damage Equal To 1d6+ Your Strength Modifier, And You Can Attempt To [[Grapple]] The Creature With The Chain. A Creature [[Grappled]] In This Way Takes 2d8 *Fire* Damage At The Start Of Each Of Its Turns.
**𝙋𝙪𝙩𝙧𝙚𝙛𝙮𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝘽𝙧𝙚𝙖𝙩𝙝:** As An [[Action]] You Can Spend Any Number Of To Exhale A 60ft [[Cone]] Of Sickening Flame. Each Creature In The Area Must Succeed On A Constitution [[Saving Throw]] And The Save DC Is Equal To 17+ The Number Of Charges Spent. On A Failed Save The Creature Takes 2d8 *Necrotic* Damage Per Charge Spent, Has [[Disadvantage]] On All Melee Attacks And Cannot Regain [[Hit Point]] For 1 Minute. On A Successful Save The Creature Takes Half As Much Damage, But Suffers No Other Effect.
**𝙃𝙮𝙥𝙤𝙜𝙚𝙖𝙣 𝙂𝙪𝙖𝙧𝙙 :** As An [[Action]] You Can Spend Any Number Of Charges To Cast *Spirit Guardian* Without Expending A Spell Slot. For Each Charge Beyond The First, The Spell Is Cast At One Level Higher, And The Save DC Is Equal TO 17+ The Number Of Charges Spent. The Guardians Appear As Three Burning Canine Heads Floating Around You. When The Spell Is Cast In This Way, The Spell Deals Your Choice Of *Fire* Or *Necrotic* Damage Rather Than It’s Normal Damage.
***Credit:*** [The Mithral Canvas Insta](https://www.instagram.com/the_mithral_canvas?)

item.name: +1 Arrow
item.description:
You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.

Arrows are used with a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a ranged attack. Each time you attack with the weapon, you expend one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition from a [[quiver]], case, or other container is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-handed weapon). At the end of the battle, you can recover half your expended ammunition by taking a minute to search the battlefield.

Arrows are typically stored in a *[[Quiver]]* (bought separately). ***Credit:*** Dungeon Master’s Guide 2024 (DMG24)

item.name: Force Absorbing Tattoo
item.description:
Produced by a special needle, this magic tattoo features designs that emphasize one color (white).

***Tattoo Attunement.*** To attune to this item, you hold the needle to your skin where you want the tattoo to appear, pressing the needle there throughout the [[attunement]] process. When the [[attunement]] is complete, the needle turns into the ink that becomes the tattoo, which appears on the skin.

If your [[attunement]] to the tattoo ends, the tattoo vanishes, and the needle reappears in your space.

***Damage Resistance.*** While the tattoo is on your skin, you have [[resistance]] to force damage.

***Damage Absorption.*** When you take force damage, you can use your [[reaction]] to gain [[immunity]] against that instance of the damage, and you regain a number of [[Hit Point|hit points]] equal to half the damage you would have taken. Once this [[reaction]] is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
***Credit:*** Tasha’s Cauldron of Everything (TCE)

item.name: Memento of the Shapeless
item.image: Memento of the Shapeless BGR PNG.png
item.description:
This weapon was forged using the preserved remains of an ancient mimic. You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. As a Bonus Action, you can use a command word to magically reshape it into any kind of Melee weapon with which you're proficient that doesn't have the Heavy or Reach property.

When you hit a creature with this weapon, you can attempt to grapple the target with it (no action required), channeling the weapon's natural pseudopod form. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or have the Grappled condition. Until the grapple ends, you can't attack or grapple another creature with the weapon. Releasing the weapon ends the condition on the target.

***Pseuperpod.*** As a Magic action, you can make a melee attack roll against a creature within 30 feet of you using the weapon. The weapon stretches toward the target as a pseudopod, ignoring Half and Three-Quarters Cover, and deals 6d8 Bludgeoning damage on a hit. After the attack, the weapon retracts back into its previous form. If you attempt to grapple the target with the attack, the save DC for the Strength saving throw increases to 15. On a failed save, the target is pulled up to 15 feet closer to you before being released from the weapon's grasp. If the target failed the save by 5 or more, it is instead pulled up to 30 feet closer to you and remains Grappled. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until 12 hours have passed.

***Limb Replacement.*** If you're missing an arm or forearm, you can graft the weapon to yourself in its place. If you do, the weapon changes and reforms to match the missing limb. You can add your Proficiency Bonus to any Strength (Athletics) check you make using the limb; your Proficiency Bonus is instead doubled for such checks if you already have proficiency in the Athletics skill. You can alter the limb's form to turn it into a weapon or revert it to match the missing limb as needed (no action required).

item.attunement: Requires [[Attunement]] By a Creature of Neutral Alignment
item.description:
This magic weapon comes from a clan of sentient wurms that debilitate their foes with strange magic. This sword has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. When you hit a creature with the sword, you can expend 1 of its charges as part of the attack to force that creature to make a DC 13 [[saving throw]] of your choice. On a failed save, a creature is subjected to an effect based on the kind of [[saving throw]] it made:

- **Strength.** The creature gains a –2 penalty to [[attack rolls]] until the end of its next turn.
- **Dexterity.** The creature's movement [[speed]] is halved until the end of its next turn.
- **Constitution.** If the creature is Large or smaller, it loses its balance and is pushed 15 feet away from you.
- **Intelligence.** The creature has [[disadvantage]] on the next spell attack it makes within 1 minute.
- **Wisdom.** The creature becomes slightly sluggish and can't take reactions until the end of its next turn.
- **Charisma.** The creature has [[disadvantage]] on attacks against creatures other than you until the end of its next turn.

item.name: Memento of the Shapeless Cavalry Hammer
item.image: Memento of the Shapeless BGR PNG.png
item.type: Weapon (Cavalry Hammer), Advanced Weapon, Melee Weapon, 3 lb.
item.description:
*1d8 Bludgeoning*
*Armor-Piercing, Momentum (1d12)*
*Mastery:  Slow*

*The *base item* can be found in Grim Hollow: Player’s Guide (2024), page 128.*

This weapon was forged using the preserved remains of an ancient [[mimic]]. You gain a +2 bonus to [[attack rolls]] and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. As a [[Bonus Action]], you can use a command word to magically reshape it into any kind of [[Melee Weapons|Melee weapon]] with which you're proficient that doesn't have the Heavy or Reach property.

When you hit a creature with this weapon, you can attempt to [[Grapple Action|grapple]] the target with it (no [[action]] required), channeling the weapon's natural pseudopod form. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength [[saving throw]] or have the [[Grappled|Grappled condition]]. Until the [[Grapple Action|grapple]] ends, you can't attack or grapple another creature with the weapon. Releasing the weapon ends the [[condition]] on the target.

***Pseuperpod.*** As a [[Magic action]], you can make a melee [[Attack Rolls|attack roll]] against a creature within 30 feet of you using the weapon. The weapon stretches toward the target as a pseudopod, ignoring Half and Three-Quarters Cover, and deals 6d8 Bludgeoning damage on a hit. After the attack, the weapon retracts back into its previous form. If you attempt to [[Grapple Action|grapple]] the target with the attack, the save DC for the Strength [[saving throw]] increases to 15. On a failed save, the target is pulled up to 15 feet closer to you before being released from the weapon's grasp. If the target failed the save by 5 or more, it is instead pulled up to 30 feet closer to you and remains [[Grappled]]. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until 12 hours have passed.

***Limb Replacement.*** If you're missing an arm or forearm, you can graft the weapon to yourself in its place. If you do, the weapon changes and reforms to match the missing limb. You can add your [[Proficiency Bonus]] to any Strength ([[Athletics]]) check you make using the limb; your [[Proficiency Bonus]] is instead doubled for such checks if you already have [[proficiency]] in the [[Athletics]] [[skill]]. You can alter the limb's form to turn it into a weapon or revert it to match the missing limb as needed (no action required).

***Armor-Piercing.*** An Armor-Piercing weapon is a Melee weapon designed to punch through armor or thick hide. When you make an [[Attack Rolls|attack roll]] using an Armor-Piercing weapon, you gain a +1 bonus to the [[Attack Rolls|attack roll]] if your target is wearing armor or has an Armor Class of 18 or higher.

***Momentum.*** Momentum weapons allow you to deliver devastating attacks as part of rapid movement. When you hit with a Momentum weapon after you moved 20 feet or more in a straight line during the same turn, upgrade the damage dice to the weapon's Momentum Dice value.

***Mastery: Slow.*** If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its [[Speed]] by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the [[Speed]] reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.
***Credit:*** The Griffon’s Saddlebag, Book 1 2024 (TGS124)

item.description:

*1d8 Bludgeoning*
*Fabled Heirloom, Two‑Handed*
*Mastery:  Push*
- - - 
This shovel features a steel blade and collar at the end of a makeshift walking stick, appearing old and well-used. It was once the shovel of Yorgrim of the Shadestone Clan, who could commune with the spirits of the dead. It occasionally emits a faint whispering sound when handled.

You gain a +1 bonus to [[attack rolls]] and damage rolls with this magic weapon determined by its rarity. While holding the shovel, you can use the following properties.

***Fabled Heirloom.*** Each Fabled Heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. The rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the Heirloom Rarity table. An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

***Mastery: Push.*** If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from yourself if it is Large or smaller.

item.name: Haemstrike (rare)
item.description:
This weapon is naturally attracted to foes bearing ferrous metals, allowing it to strike them with more force. Those who align themselves more closely with the weapon are granted the ability to manipulate gravity, telekinetically pulling creatures and objects into range of its jagged-faced swings.

The weapon has a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. If the target is made of ferrous metal or is wearing ferrous armour, increase the bonus to +3.

**Optional Attunement.** If you choose to attune to this weapon, it gains the Attraction and Magnetic Shockwave properties. When you activate a property granted by this optional attunement, roll a d4. On a 1, haemstrike's optional [[attunement]] properties can't be activated until the next dawn.
**Attraction.** As a [[bonus action]], you can point haemstrike at a target you can see within **30 feet** of you. If the target is an object that weighs less than **600 pounds**, the object is pulled up to **15 feet** towards you. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength [[saving throw]] or be pulled up to **15 feet** straight towards you. If the creature is made of ferrous metal or is wearing ferrous armour, it has [[disadvantage]] on the [[saving throw]]. Huge or larger creatures automatically succeed on this [[saving throw]].
**Magnetic Shockwave.** Once per turn when you hit a target with haemstrike, you can cause an eruption of supercooled magnetite shards. Each creature other than you within **5 feet** of the target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity [[saving throw]], taking 1d6 cold damage and 1d6 piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success. Creatures made of ferrous metal or wearing ferrous armour have [[disadvantage]] on this [[saving throw]].
***Base items.*** This item variant can be applied to the following base items:

- *[[Hammer]]* (*[[Hammer Haemstrike (rare)]]*)
- *[[Heavy Hammer]]* (*[[Heavy Hammer Haemstrike (rare)]]*)
- *[[Light Hammer]]* (*[[Light Hammer Haemstrike (rare)]]*)
- *[[Maul]]* (*[[Maul Haemstrike (rare)]]*)
- *[[Warhammer]]* (*[[Warhammer Haemstrike (rare)]]*)

***Credit:*** Heliana’s Guide to Monster Hunting (GHtMH)

A creature that steps on the plate must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity [[saving throw]] or take 1d4 Piercing damage and have its [[Speed]] reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. Thereafter, until the creature breaks free of the trap, its movement is limited by the length of the chain (typically 3 feet). A creature can use its [[action]] to make a DC 13 Strength ([[Athletics]]) check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. Each failed check deals 1 Piercing damage to the trapped creature.

*Vestige*

When the item reaches its exalted state, it gains a major beneficial property. See "Artifact Properties" in chapter 7 of the Dungeon Master's Guide for more information.

item.name: Peripheral Hide
item.description:
Space itself seems to bend around this armor, hiding the wearer even in plain sight. You gain a +1 bonus to AC against creatures who lack *[[Blindsight]]*, *Tremorsense*, or *[[Truesight]]*. Additionally, other creatures have [[disadvantage]] on Wisdom ([[Perception]]) checks made against you.

**Uncanny Cloaking:** You can take a [[Magic Action]] to gain the [[Invisible condition]] for 10 minutes or until you end it early on your (no [[action]] required). A creatures that is aware of you can make a DC 17 [[Perception]] check. On a success, the creature can see you normally for the next minute and you become aware of that creature. A creature with *[[Truesight]]* succeeds automatically. You can’t use this property again until you finish a [[Long Rest]].

**Curse: Perception Hunter:** This armor is cursed, a fact that is revealed only when the *[[Identify]]* spell is cast on the armor or you attune to it. Attuning to the armor curses you until you are targeted by a *[[Remove Curse]]* spell or similar magic; removing the armor fails to end the curse.

Whenever a creature succeeds on a Wisdom ([[Perception]]) check made against you while you are hiding, you must make a DC 15 Wisdom [[Saving throw]]. On a failure, you are filled with a compulsion to hunt and kill the creature that perceived you. You must use your turn to move close enough to the creature to attack it until the target is reduced to 0 [[Hit Point|hit points]] or [[incapacitated]]. If another creature perceives you and fail your [[Saving Throw]] for that creature, it becomes the new target of your compulsion on a success. Once you succeed on your [[Saving Throw]], you are immune to this curse’s effects for the next 24 hours.

- - -

*”This rough leather continues to hum and vibrate with a curios energy long after being tanned and preserved, always cloaking its wearer in a fog of imperceptibility.”*
***Credit:*** [the_mithral_canval](https://www.instagram.com/the_mithral_canvas) (Homebrew)

item.description:
- Critical Hits from attacks made with Scythe of Doom deal extra 10 necrotic damage, this damage cannot be reduced in any way.

**Fated Outcome:** Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack made with this magical weapon, you can use your reaction to cast a looming lethal curse upon them that lasts until the end of  your next turn. While a target is cursed by this feature, you can use these extra features against them:
- **Final Moments:** If the cursed target has 30 or fewer Hit Points, you can use your bonus action to make them die instantly
- **Coup de Grâce:** When you hit a cursed creature with this weapon, you can use your reaction to force them to make a DC17 Wisdom saving throw, turning the hit into a critical hit on a failure
- **Fear the Reaper:** When you hit a cursed creature with this weapon, you can use your reaction to force them to make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw, making them lose their reaction and they become frightened until the end of their next turn on a failure.
- **Deadly Reflex:**  When a cursed creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points, you regain the use of your reaction and can immediately make a melee attack with Scythe of Doom against a creature within reach.

While a creature is affected by this weapon’s curse, you gain disadvantage on all attack rolls against other creatures, and you take 2d10 psychic damage if you don’t deal any damage against the cursed creature during your turn.

item.description:
*1d6 Slashing*

*Finesse, Light*

*Mastery:  Nick*

---

***Upkeep.*** When you make an [[Attack Rolls|attack roll]] with a silver weapon or piece of ammunition, it takes a cumulative -1 penalty to [[attack rolls]]. The weapon or piece of ammunition is destroyed if the penalty reaches -5. The penalty can be removed by casting the *[[Mending]]* spell on the object or by succeeding on a DC 10 Dexterity check using *[[Smith's Tools]]* as part of a [[Short Rest]] or [[Long Rest]].

***Finesse.*** When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

***Light.*** When you take the [[Attack action]] on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a [[Bonus Action]] later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a *[[Shortsword]]* in one hand and a *[[Dagger]]* in the other using the [[Attack action]] and a [[Bonus Action]], but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the [[Bonus Action]] unless that modifier is negative.

***Mastery: Nick.*** When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the [[Attack action]] instead of as a [[Bonus Action]]. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.
***Credit:*** Vampire: The Masquerade - Bound by Blood (VtMBB)

item.description:
